description.value: Fudo is a Japanese restaurant and sushi bar that opened in 2017 at Broadmead Village Shopping Centre, specializing in traditional and fusion cuisine under Executive Chef Yang, one of Victoria's only female sushi chefs. The restaurant is known for locally sourced BC seafood — including spot prawns, sockeye salmon, and bluefin tuna — and has been voted best Japanese food in Victoria by Yam Magazine. Raku Ramen is also served on-site, rounding out the menu for cyclists looking for a substantial, varied meal.
